title.narrative: South Kordofan - Food Security Response (SCI, PLAN, GOAL)

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe intervention aims to prevent acute malnutrition in vulnerable children under 5 and pregnant and breastfeeding women and girls during the hunger gap/lean season. It uses a tested modality by WFP and FMoH of Sudan, including mass MUAC and Oedema screening, family MUAC approach, cooking demonstrations, and SBCC sessions on IYCF, WASH, and Health. The project integrates with FSL, WASH, and CASH interventions for a holistic approach to malnutrition prevention and resilience building.ltbrgtSince the conflict eruption on April 15th, 2023, food security has worsened. Conflict and economic decline have driven about 20.3 million people in Sudan into high levels of acute food insecurity. Food insecurity rates in West Darfur, South Kordofan, Central Darfur, Blue Nile, and North Kordofan are among the highest in the country. Sudan is among the top four countries globally with the highest prevalence of global acute malnutrition.ltbrgt ltbrgtIn response to the food crisis in SCI, PLAN, and GOAL propose an integrated multi-sector project targeting individuals in South Kordofan state. The goal is to provide nutrition, WASH, CASH, and FSL services, aimed at increasing community resilience and preventing food insecurity. SCI will focus on Abu Gebeha locality to respond by implementing the Aisda Plus approach to provide cooking demonstrations to local communities to enable them to tackle nutritional food insecurity. The nutritional intervention will be accompanied by WASH activities to support the community members. ltbrgtSCI will respond to 39327 beneficiaries. Also, for those who have livestock that is in danger due to the lack of services since the conflict erupted, SCI will support veteran services, such as vaccination and community awareness raising to tackle food insecurity. ltbrgtPlan International Sudan (PIS) will contribute to the consortium with an integrated response in Water, Hygiene Sanitation (WASH), Food Security Livelihoods, and Nutrition response in Dilling and Habila localities of the Greater Kordofan. The response in Dilling will focus on FSL (Seed Distribution), Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA), and WASH programs (63973 beneficiaries), while the response in Habila will focus on providing MPCA to Habila IDPs settled in Dilling (49,543 beneficiaries). This is motivated by the inaccessibility of Habila due to the security situation and the lack of Plan’s presence in the area.ltbrgtGOAL will also provide integrated health and nutrition services in Rashad with targeted supplementary feeding program (TSFP) and outpatient therapeutic program (OTP) services including food processing and demonstrations which will directly address the multi-sectoral causes of malnutrition, such as inadequate diet diversity, poor WASH behaviors, and unsafe food preparation and conservation methods(30,000 nutrition beneficiaries, and 6,600 FSL beneficiaries) . In addition, GOAL will implement seed fairs and Multipurpose Cash Assistance in Dilling (300 Beneficiaries). ltbrgtlt/pgt
